name: Ribbit Jump
storyline:
The Journey of Precision

In a world where every leap could be your last, a small hero faces a monumental challenge. Ribbit Jump is more than just a climb; it is a test of patience, focus, and mastery.

Easy to learn, hard to master
The journey begins with simple mechanics, but do not be fooled. A single mistake in measuring your jump strength will lead to a collision, forcing you to learn from your errors and perfect your movements.

Rising to the Challenge
As you progress through 3 unique biomes, the environment becomes your greatest rival. From the first platforms to the most complex hazard-filled sections, you must achieve total control over your leaps to overcome the 50 levels that stand between you and victory. Every star collected and every rescue mission completed tells the story of a player who refused to give up.
summary: A precision platformer where every move counts. Adjust the strength of each jump to progress through an increasingly demanding level design. Conquer 50 obstacle-filled levels and master every leap across diverse environments.
